title: To them or to you
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The tech asks if he answered Portland. Wood says he said no. The tech says to them or to you. Wood runs the week's strips without answering. The tech doesn't ask again. He put it on the counter though.

panels.composition: The print shop. The TECH. WOOD with the strips. BARNABY on the counter.

image.prompt: a print technician at a copier and a young man at the counter with a small dog, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood, putting strips under the lid. Not answering.

image.prompt: close on a young man placing strips under a photocopier's lid, face turned away, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The copies stacking. The tech folding. Silence, drawn as a panel with no balloon and the machine's hum as a line.

image.prompt: a technician folding warm photocopies in silence beside a humming machine, a young man waiting, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The counter after: the stack, the dog, and a course catalog the tech has set down, open, not pointed at. Wood leaves it there.

image.prompt: close on a print shop counter with a stack of booklets, a small dog, and an open course catalog left lying nearby, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: 'To them or to you.' The catalog on the counter, not pointed at.
